Stated Claim / Post Context:
Trump suggests allowing Iran to "take out" LA and San Diego during campaign rally

Gov. Gavin Newsom called President Trump "deranged and dangerous" after he suggested letting Iran "take out" Los Angeles and San Diego.

Actual Article Body:
Watch CBS News

Updated on:  October 5, 2026 / 10:41 PM PDT
            / CBS LA

Gov. Gavin Newsom rebuked President Trump after he suggested letting Iran "take out" Los Angeles and San Diego during a campaign rally in Nebraska.

"It's a small price to pay for keeping the world safe, keeping our country safe," Mr. Trump said. "They can take out a city. Let them take out Los Angeles. Let them take out San Diego."

Attendees cheered after his suggestion.

"After sending the National Guard and Marines to occupy California, Donald Trump is now saying our foreign enemies should 'take out' Los Angeles and San Diego," Newsom wrote on X. "He is deranged and dangerous."
